boundaryCondition.description: A boundary condition of the adjoint scalar.
boundaryCondition.$comment: Factory: sources/adjoint/adjoint_scalar_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:73-91 (no fallback). `dirichlet` and `neumann` are read by Neko's classes, so Neko's union is reused; its `user_dirichlet` and the other types are not factory cases here. The adjoint's `user` type is not in Neko's union and is a branch of its own (the factory fills in `field_name`).

zone_indices.description: Zone indices, a literal array of JSON integers.
Zone indices, a literal array of JSON integers.

solver.description: Solver of the adjoint scalar. Each key that is absent here is read from `case.scalar.solver`.
solver.$comment: Neko's linear solver objects are open (registered Krylov types define their own keys), so this one is too. sources/adjoint/adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:288-316,376-385.

type.description: Krylov solver type. Falls back to `case.scalar.solver.type`.

absolute_tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance, a JSON real (no constants name).

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.scalar.solver.max_iterations`, else 1000.

projection_space_size.description: Projection space size, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default 0.

projection_hold_steps.description: Projection hold steps, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default 5.

adjointScalar.description: `case.adjoint_scalar`: the adjoint of the scalar transport equation (a single scalar).

enabled.description: Enable the adjoint scalar. Default true.

primal_name.description: Name of the primal scalar field; must equal `case.scalar.name`. Default `s`.

name.description: Name of the adjoint scalar. Default `<primal_name>_adj`.

advection.description: Advection of the adjoint scalar. Default true.

dealias_coupling_term.description: Dealias the coupling term of the adjoint momentum equation. Default `case.numerics.dealias`, else true.

boundary_conditions.description: Adjoint scalar boundary conditions; every labelled zone of the mesh needs exactly one.

initial_condition.description: Initial condition of the adjoint scalar (required; reset every design iteration).

allOf.$comment: adjoint_case.f90:332 and neko_ext.f90:438 abort on a `user` adjoint scalar initial condition.
adjoint_case.f90:309-312 and neko_ext.f90:420-423 read initial_condition.type of an enabled adjoint scalar without a default.
